Audit sub-agent A (offline) — verdict: CONFIRMED, fix committed.

Branch: audit/c2-leaf-gap-agent
Commit: 04daf0a81d61a97235f4f52ef59a24988ed6b914
Base: fix/c2-outbound-update-propagation

AUDIT FINDINGS:
(a) Dispatch routing: outbound UPDATE typed Mutations from a full reconcile run (apply() called with a LIST) go through _mutation_to_batch_dict → _apply_batch → update_one (legacy batch path). The typed leaf _apply_outbound_update is only reached when apply() is called with a SINGLE Mutation (typed dispatch path). Both paths now exist in production code.

(b) CONFIRMED GAP: _apply_outbound_update (applier.py lines 258-314 on base branch) has _OUTBOUND_UPDATE_ALLOWLIST = frozenset({'summary','description','assignee','priority'}) — NO labels, NO comments. The function never reads payload['labels'] or payload['comments']. update_one (legacy path, ~lines 1744-1779) DOES handle labels and comments correctly (bug 87e4 fix).

(c) changed_fields empty path: When a mutation only has label/comment changes, changed_fields={}, allowed={}, client.update_issue is NOT called, and the function returns ApplyResult with fields_pushed=[] and no warning — silent success. No non-empty guard existed on the base branch.

(d) CREATE path: create_one handles labels and comments indirectly — _mutation_to_batch_dict surfaces them in the batch dict, and create_one adds the dso-id label post-create. Standard user labels from the CREATE payload were NOT being added via add_label in create_one — they are threaded through the batch dict's labels key but create_one only calls add_label for dso-id. This is a separate, narrower gap.

(e) Idempotency (21 persistent mutations): The outbound differ (outbound_differ.py) compares local ticket fields against the Jira snapshot fetched at pass start. If the typed leaf UPDATE succeeds but labels/comments are not written to Jira, the NEXT pass re-fetches Jira and still sees stale labels/comments → the differ re-emits the same mutations → 21 persists across consecutive passes. The local store is never the divergence point — the differ always re-derives from a fresh Jira fetch vs. local ticket state. Idempotency convergence requires the Jira writes to actually land.

FIX IMPLEMENTED: Extended _apply_outbound_update to:
1. Read payload['labels'] and dispatch add_label/remove_label per entry (matching update_one pattern)
2. Read payload['comments'] and dispatch add_comment per entry (matching update_one pattern)
3. Emit WARNING when effective work set (allowed + labels + comments) is all empty — loud skip guard
4. Return labels_applied and comments_applied in ApplyResult payload for observability

Tests added: 6 new tests covering all new behaviors. All 12 tests in test_applier_outbound_update.py pass. The 21 pre-existing failures in the full suite (inbound path _Client.add_label AttributeError) predate this change and were confirmed failing before the fix.

Assessment: With this fix, BOTH tickets should be closeable pending live-probe confirmation (sub-agent B). The typed-leaf gap is the structural cause of silent no-ops. The legacy batch path (update_one) was already fixed by bug 87e4.
